# Regexes (grep -E) matched against changed file paths. If every file in a merge
# group matches, the merge queue skips the integration tests.
\.md$
^docs/
^LICENSE
^legal/
^\.github/
# .txt/.yaml files only at the repository root. Those under modules/ are test inputs
# (e.g. TestNG filters.txt, apiSwaggerFiles/scim2.yaml), so changes there still run the tests.
^[^/]+\.txt$
^[^/]+\.ya?ml$
